inputText: This is Kaf — KAHF. Sound: K as in kite with a dot; throaty KH without the dot. Shape hook: rounded open-left mitten. Tip: Its upper-left turn is smooth, unlike Bet’s boxy square roof and floor; do not mix it up with Bet, Pe.
